verdict.rationale: Paychex documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0, versioning, paging and webhooks, but nothing in the evidence mentions a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404, so there is no evidence the capability exists, though the spec could sit at a non-standard path.
